company.name: Contractbook
company.shortDescription: Contractbook’s contract management software empowers modern businesses to turn manual processes into fully automated workflows.
company.description: Contractbook’s contract management software empowers modern businesses to turn manual processes into fully automated workflows. This means anyone can work effortlessly with contracts across the entire lifecycle, regardless of role or familiarity. Create and sign seamlessly. Collaborate with your team. Manage all your documents in one place. And automate the process to achieve efficiency. Funded by investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Gradient Ventures, Contractbook was founded in Copenhagen in 2017 and serves over 250,000 users in more than 85 countries. Learn more about how Contractbook makes working with contracts an easy, efficient, and stress-free experience at www.contractbook.com.
